AddRcsSignMenu.description_en: Creates or edits a 5G message persistent menu
AddRcsSignMenu.description_zh: 创建或编辑5G消息固定菜单

AddTemplateSignRel.description_en: Associates signatures with a template. After signatures are associated with a template, the SMS service specifications of the template are applied when the template is used to send messages
AddTemplateSignRel.description_zh: 新增模版关联签名。给模板关联的签名，后续使用这个模板发送时，都会应用模板对应的短信服务规格

ChangeSignatureQualification.description_en: Replaces the qualification and authorization letter for a signature
ChangeSignatureQualification.description_zh: 更换签名的资质和授权书

CheckMobilesCardSupport.description_en: Checks whether a phone number supports card messages
CheckMobilesCardSupport.description_zh: 检查手机号码是否支持卡片短信

ConversionDataIntl.description_en: Reports SMS conversion rate statistics to the Alibaba Cloud SMS platform
ConversionDataIntl.description_zh: 将短信转化率统计数据反馈给阿里云短信平台

CreateDigitalSignOrder.description_en: Manages digital SMS signature operation orders
CreateDigitalSignOrder.description_zh: 数字短信签名操作订单

CreateDigitalSmsTemplate.description_en: Creates a digital short message template

CreateRCSMobileCapableTask.description_en: Creates an asynchronous task to query the 5G capability of mobile devices
CreateRCSMobileCapableTask.description_zh: 创建终端5G适配情况查询任务（异步）

CreateSmsAppIcpRecord.description_en:
Signature sources of online apps are no longer supported.
Creates an APP-ICP filing entity. Scenarios: when the signature source is set to APP, ICP filing information needs to be uploaded
CreateSmsAppIcpRecord.description_zh:
不再支持签名来源为已上线APP。
创建APP-ICP备案实体。使用场景是签名来源=APP时，需要上传ICP备案信息

CreateSmsAuthorizationLetter.description_en: Creates an authorization letter. If the qualification is applied for third-party use or the signature involves third-party rights, you must obtain third-party authorization and create an authorization letter before submitting the application
CreateSmsAuthorizationLetter.description_zh: 若申请的资质用途为他用或申请的签名涉及第三方权益，则必须获取第三方授权，并在申请前提前创建授权委托书

CreateSmsSign.description_en: Applies for an SMS signature. An SMS signature identifies the sender. Before sending messages, you must apply for a signature and a template. The system adds the approved signature to the beginning of the message content and sends it together with the message to the recipient
CreateSmsSign.description_zh: 短信签名作为短信发送方的一种标识，发送短信前，您需要先申请签名和模板，系统会将已审核通过的短信签名添加到短信内容的开头，并与短信内容一起发送给接收方

CreateSmsTemplate.description_en: An SMS template defines the content that recipients receive, including variables and template body. You can apply for verification code, notification, or promotional SMS templates based on your business needs. Messages can be sent only after the template is approved
CreateSmsTemplate.description_zh: 短信模板即接收方收到短信的详细内容，包括变量和模板内容。您可以根据业务需要，申请验证码、通知短信或推广短信，模板审核通过后才可以发送短信

CreateSmsTrademark.description_en: Creates a trademark entity. Scenarios: when the signature source is a trademark, trademark information needs to be uploaded
CreateSmsTrademark.description_zh: 创建商标实体。使用场景是签名来源=商标时，需要上传商标信息

DeleteShortUrl.description_en: Deletes a short URL. After deletion, the short URL becomes unusable and cannot be restored to the original URL
DeleteShortUrl.description_zh: 删除短链，删除后短链将无法使用，无法还原为原链

DeleteSmsQualification.description_en: Deletes an SMS qualification that is no longer needed
DeleteSmsQualification.description_zh: 若您不再使用某个短信资质或因其他原因需要删除时，调用此接口或在短信服务控制台删除短信资质

DeleteSmsSign.description_en: Deletes an SMS signature that is no longer needed
DeleteSmsSign.description_zh: 如果您不再使用某个短信签名，需要删除签名时，调用此接口或在短信服务控制台删除短信签名

DeleteSmsTemplate.description_en: Deletes an SMS template that is no longer needed
DeleteSmsTemplate.description_zh: 如果您不再使用某个短信模板，需要删除模板时，调用此接口或在短信服务控制台删除短信模板

DeleteTemplateSignRel.description_en: Dissociates signatures from a template. After the dissociation, the SMS service specifications associated with the signatures no longer apply when the template is used to send messages
DeleteTemplateSignRel.description_zh: 解除模版关联签名。解除关联之后，使用这个模板发送时，不再会应用该短信服务规格

GetCardSmsDetails.description_en: Queries the sending records and sending status of card SMS messages for a single phone number
GetCardSmsDetails.description_zh: 查询单个号码的卡片短信发送记录和发送状态等信息

GetCardSmsLink.description_en: Retrieves short URLs for card SMS messages

GetMediaResourceId.description_en: Converts images and videos uploaded by users to the card message OSS storage into resource data for unified management, and returns resource IDs that users can manage on their own
GetMediaResourceId.description_zh: 将用户上传到卡片短信OSS存储的图片、视频转换成（生成）资源数据统一管理，并返回资源ID，用户可以对返回的资源ID自行管理

GetOSSInfoForCardTemplate.description_en: Retrieves the OSS resource configuration information for card messages. This information is used for subsequent OSS file upload operations
GetOSSInfoForCardTemplate.description_zh: 获取卡片短信所属OSS资源配置信息，此配置信息将用于后续OSS文件上传操作

GetOSSInfoForUploadFile.description_en: Retrieves the OSS resource configuration information that is used for subsequent OSS file upload operations
GetOSSInfoForUploadFile.description_zh: 获取OSS资源配置信息，此配置信息将用于后续OSS文件上传操作

GetQualificationOssInfo.description_en: Obtains the OSS resource configuration information for qualification materials. This configuration information will be used for subsequent uploads of qualification files such as authorization letters and enterprise certificates
GetQualificationOssInfo.description_zh: 获取资质材料OSS资源配置信息，此配置信息将用于后续授权委托书、企业证件等资质文件的上传操作

GetRCSSignature.description_en: Queries the details of a 5G message signature
GetRCSSignature.description_zh: 查询5G消息签名的详细信息

GetSmsOcrOssInfo.description_en: Retrieves the OSS information for OCR
GetSmsOcrOssInfo.description_zh: 获取 OCR 的 OSS 信息

GetSmsSign.description_en: Queries the review details of a signature after you submit a signature application
GetSmsSign.description_zh: 申请签名后，通过此接口查询签名审核详情

GetSmsTemplate.description_en: Queries the review details of an SMS template after you submit the template for review. You can view the template review status
GetSmsTemplate.description_zh: 申请模板后，通过此接口查询模板审核详情，可查看模板审核状态

GetSmsTemplateList.description_en: Queries the details of a template list (new operation)
GetSmsTemplateList.description_zh: 查询模板列表详情（新接口）

ListTagResources.description_en: Tags are markers that you add to templates. Each tag consists of a key-value pair (Key-Value). You can query the template codes bound to a tag key-value pair, or query all tags bound to a specific template
ListTagResources.description_zh: 标签是您为模板添加的标记，每个标签都由一对键值对（Key-Value）组成。您可以查询标签键值对绑定的模板Code，也可以查询某个模板已绑定的所有标签

QueryCardSmsTemplate.description_en: Queries the review status of a card message template and returns review information from mobile phone manufacturers
QueryCardSmsTemplate.description_zh: 查询卡片短信模板审核状态，返回手机厂商审核相关信息

QueryCardSmsTemplateReport.description_en: Queries the parsing data of a specified card SMS template. The parsing data includes the number of successful SMS parsing receipts, the number of message exposures, and the number of message clicks
QueryCardSmsTemplateReport.description_zh: 查询卡片短信指定模板的解析数据，解析数据包括短信解析回执成功数、消息曝光次数和消息点击数等

QueryDigitalSignByName.description_en: Retrieves the details of a digital SMS signature by its name
QueryDigitalSignByName.description_zh: 获取数字短信签名通过的签名name

QueryMobilesCardSupport.description_en: Queries whether a phone number supports card SMS messages
QueryMobilesCardSupport.description_zh: 查询手机号是否支持卡片短信

QueryRCSAssetDetail.description_en: Queries the details of a single 5G message asset
QueryRCSAssetDetail.description_zh: 单个查询5G消息素材详情

QueryRCSAssetList.description_en: Queries the details of 5G message assets in batches
QueryRCSAssetList.description_zh: 批量查询5G消息素材详情

QueryRCSMobileCapable.description_en: Queries the 5G messaging compatibility of multiple phone numbers in a synchronous batch request
QueryRCSMobileCapable.description_zh: 批量同步查询终端对5G消息的适配情况

QueryRCSMobileCapableTaskResult.description_en: Queries the task result of a 5G capability check for mobile devices
QueryRCSMobileCapableTaskResult.description_zh: 查询终端5G适配情况任务结果

QueryRCSTemplate.description_en: Queries the details of a 5G message template
QueryRCSTemplate.description_zh: 查询5G消息模板的详细信息

QueryRcsSignMenuByVersion.description_en: Queries the details of a 5G message persistent menu by a specified version
QueryRcsSignMenuByVersion.description_zh: 指定版本查看5G消息固定菜单详情

QuerySendDetails.description_en: Queries the SMS sending records and sending status of a single phone number
QuerySendDetails.description_zh: 查询单个号码的短信发送记录和发送状态等信息

QuerySendStatistics.description_en: Queries the statistics on SMS messages sent, including the sending time, the number of successfully sent messages, and the number of receipts received
QuerySendStatistics.description_zh: 查询短信发送统计详情，包括短信发送时间、短信发送成功条数、接收回执条数等

QueryShortUrl.description_en: Checks the status and availability of a short link
QueryShortUrl.description_zh: 查询短链状态，可判断短链是否可用

QuerySingleSmsQualification.description_en: After you apply for SMS qualifications, you can call this operation to query the details of a single qualification
QuerySingleSmsQualification.description_zh: 当您在申请短信资质后，可以通过此接口查询单个资质详情

QuerySmsAuthorizationLetter.description_en: Queries created letters of authorization. You can view the review status and authorized signature scope of the letters
QuerySmsAuthorizationLetter.description_zh: 查询已创建的授权委托书，可查看授权书审核状态、授权签名范围

QuerySmsQualificationRecord.description_en: Queries a list of SMS qualifications and their review details after you submit qualification applications. This operation supports filtered query
QuerySmsQualificationRecord.description_zh: 当您在申请短信资质后，可以通过此接口查询资质列表及其审核详情，支持条件筛选查询

QuerySmsSign.description_en: Queries the review status of an SMS signature

QuerySmsSignList.description_en: Queries all signatures under your account, allowing you to view signature details, including the signature approval status, signature type, and signature name
QuerySmsSignList.description_zh: 可以通过此接口可以查询您账号下的所有签名，方便您查看签名详情，包括签名审核状态、签名类型、签名名称等

QuerySmsTemplateList.description_en: Queries all templates under your account to view template details, including template review status, templatetype, and template content
QuerySmsTemplateList.description_zh: 可以通过此接口查询您账号下的所有模板，方便您查看模板详情，包括模板审核状态、模板类型、模板内容等

QuerySmsTrademark.description_en: Queries the details of trademark entities
QuerySmsTrademark.description_zh: 查询商标实体详情信息

RequiredPhoneCode.description_en: Obtains an SMS verification code for verifying the administrator phone number when applying for SMS qualifications
RequiredPhoneCode.description_zh: 申请短信资质时，需要验证管理员手机号，请通过本接口获取短信验证码

SendBatchCardSms.description_en: Sends card messages to multiple recipients in a batch

SendBatchSms.description_en: This operation sends messages to different phone numbers using a single template, with different signatures and template variables for each recipient
SendBatchSms.description_zh: 调用此接口可以给不同的手机号码，发送不同签名、同一个模板（可以是不同模板变量）的短信

SendRCSReply.description_en: Sends an interactive downlink 5G message to reply to a user's uplink message
SendRCSReply.description_zh: 发送交互下行的5G消息，回复用户的上行消息

SendSms.description_en: Sends an SMS message to one or more specified mobile numbers
SendSms.description_zh: 向指定的手机号码发送短信

SendTestVerification.description_en: Sends a test verification code SMS message

SmsConversionIntl.description_en: Reports the delivery status of each message (by MessageId) to the Alibaba Cloud international SMS platform
SmsConversionIntl.description_zh: 将每一条消息ID(MessageId) 对应短信的接收情况反馈给阿里云国际短信平台

SubmitSmsQualification.description_en: Submits an SMS qualification application. As required by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) and carriers for real-name SMS sending, domestic SMS services require qualification credentials of the signature owner. Apply for an SMS qualification first, and then apply for signatures and templates
SubmitSmsQualification.description_zh: 根据工信部及运营商实名制发送短信的要求，国内短信需提供签名归属方的资质证件信息。请先申请短信资质，然后再申请签名和模板

TagResources.description_en: Tags can mark resources, allowing enterprises or individuals to categorize templates of the same type for easier search and resource aggregation. Calls this operation to attach tags to SMS templates
TagResources.description_zh: 标签可以标记资源，允许企业或个人将同类型的模板进行资源归类，便于搜索和资源聚合。调用本接口对短信模板进行标签绑定

UntagResources.description_en: Tags can mark resources, allowing enterprises or individuals to categorize templates of the same type for easier search and resource aggregation. If a template is no longer applicable to its currently bound tags, you can unbind the tags from the template. You can delete a single tag or delete tags in batches
UntagResources.description_zh: 标签可以标记资源，允许企业或个人将同类型的模板进行资源归类，便于搜索和资源聚合。如果模板不再适用于当前已绑定的标签，可以从模板中解绑标签。您可以删除单个标签，也可以批量删除标签

UpdateRCSSignature.description_en: Edits the information of an existing 5G message signature
UpdateRCSSignature.description_zh: 编辑已有的5G消息签名信息

UpdateSmsQualification.description_en: Submits a modification request to update SMS qualification information. After submission, the qualification re-enters the review process
UpdateSmsQualification.description_zh: 如果您需要更新短信资质信息，可通过本接口提交修改请求，提交后将重新进入审核流程

UpdateSmsSign.description_en: Modifies an SMS signature that has failed or passed the review. After the modification, the signature is automatically submitted for review and enters the pending review state via autocommit
UpdateSmsSign.description_zh: 修改未通过审核和已经审核通过的签名，修改完成后自动提交审核，签名进入待审核状态

UpdateSmsTemplate.description_en: Modifies an SMS template that failed the review. The modified template is automatically submitted for review after this operation is called
UpdateSmsTemplate.description_zh: 修改未通过审核的模板，调用本接口修改后将自动提交审核

UpgradeToRCSSignature.description_en: Upgrades an approved text SMS signature to a 5G messaging signature
UpgradeToRCSSignature.description_zh: 将已通过审核的文本短信签名升级为5G消息签名

ValidPhoneCode.description_en: Verifies the phone number and the verification code received when applying for SMS qualifications, which requires administrator phone number verification
ValidPhoneCode.description_zh: 申请短信资质时，需要验证管理员手机号，本接口可对手机号及收到的验证码进行验证
